newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rises one cent to 14.87 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rises one cent to 14.87 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose a cent to 14.87 ringgit ($5.95) a kg on short-covering by Europeans and locals despite overnight losses on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The market didn't react to the higher LME on Friday and as a result, saw some covering today," said a dealer. The LME rose $65 on Friday and fell by the same value on Monday.

Turnover on the local market fell to 71 tonnes from 79 on Monday. Bids totalled 81 tonnes against offers of 75. The local price fetched a premium of $60 against the LME, compared to $10 previously. -- Barani Krishnaan (603-230-7509) ($1=2.5005 rgt)
